body: NIST DLMF section 4.11 (Sums) says: "For infinite series involving logarithms and/or exponentials, see Gradshteyn and Ryzhik ( 2015 , Chapter 1) , Hansen ( 1975 , §44) , and Prudnikov et al. ( 1986a , Chapter 5) ." This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
